templates.name: secret-scanning-disabled
templates.title: Secret scanning is disabled
templates.statement: The repository has secret scanning disabled, which may allow secrets to be committed undetected.

remediation-template.title: Enable secret scanning
remediation-template.description: Enable secret scanning on the repository to detect committed secrets.

tasks.title: Navigate to repository Settings > Security > Secret scanning
Enable secret scanning and push protection

templates.name: branch-protection-missing
templates.title: Branch protection rules are not configured
templates.statement: The default branch has no protection rules, allowing force pushes and direct commits.

remediation-template.title: Configure branch protection
remediation-template.description: Add branch protection rules to prevent force pushes and require reviews.

tasks.title: Go to Settings > Branches > Branch protection rules
Add rule for the default branch requiring at least 1 approval

templates.name: mfa-not-required
templates.title: Multi-factor authentication is not enforced
templates.statement: Organisation members are not required to use MFA, increasing the risk of account takeover.

templates.name: public-repo-with-sensitive-data
templates.title: Public repository may expose sensitive data
templates.statement: The repository is public and may inadvertently expose sensitive configuration or credentials.

templates.name: dependency-review-disabled
templates.title: Dependency review is not enabled
templates.statement: Dependency review is disabled, so vulnerable dependencies may be introduced via pull requests.

remediation-template.title: Enable dependency review
remediation-template.description: Enable the dependency review GitHub Action to block PRs introducing known vulnerabilities.
